source_spans.text: When only GSR is selected (NO ECG0 and PPG are selected), if i_m_gsr [SET_GSR_FREQ_h and SET_GSR_FREQ_l] is greater than 0, the Device FSM shall go in SLEEP after the IDLE State and shall go back in Operative State only when the measurement shall be run or, in case of cds disabled, when the o_gsr_curr shall change its polarity.
In Order to enable a GSR Channel Operation, the user shall always select the GSR channel (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL) and set the i_M_GSR greater than zero.
If the user set a value greater than 1024 into ones of the m_channel (see req 5004), the value shall clamp at 1024 (check the input i_m_ecg, i_m_bia, i_m_gsr or i_m_ppg into the main controller fsm)

If the en_gsr_cds [bit 3 of GSR_CTRL] is set High, the i_m_gsr shall define also in which time slot after the GSR_Curr_on falls from 1 to 0, an acquisition without current injection (o_gsr_curr_on set to 0) shall be performed.
The i_m_gsr [SET_GSR_FREQ_h and SET_GSR_FREQ_l] shall define how many time slots pass between two GSR acquisitions following this formula: GSRdata = time_slot 2 ∗ m_gsr .

source_spans.text: When the HC_EN (ECG_CTRL register [0]) is set to 0 and IMP_EN (IMP_CTRL register [0]) is set to 1 and ECG1_ECG2_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [1]) is set to 1, ECG1 and ECG2 shall be active so, when MODE_OPERATION (DEVICE_CONFIG_OPERATION register [1:0] ) is set different from 0, the O_PD_HC2 shall remain high, O_PD_IMP shall go low and the Device_FSM shall go to the WAIT_SU State, so main_controller_status_register (DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) shall be equal to 0x03.
When the i_hc_en is set to 1 and i_imp_en is set to 0 and i_n_ecg_channel is equal to 1, ECG0 shall be active so the o_pd_hc2 shall go low and counter shall be work.

When the i_hc_en is set to 1 and i_imp_en is set to 1 and i_n_ecg_channel is equal to 3, ECG0- ECG1 and ECG2 shall be active so the o_pd_hc2 shall go low, o_pd_imp shall go low and counter shall be work.

[Covers: DDS_STBIO1_0119] When the FSM is in IDLE State, if ECG0_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [0]) is high, HC_EN (ECG_CTRL register [0]) is set to 1 and IMP_EN (IMP_CTRL register [0]) is set to 0, ECG0 shall be active so, when MODE_OPERATION (DEVICE_CONFIG_OPERATION register [1:0] ) is set different from 0, the O_PD_HC2 shall go low and the Device_FSM FSM shall go to the WAIT_SU State , so the main_controller_status_register (DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) shall be equal to 0x03.
15ms after that the o_pd_hc2 is gone low, the o_rst_hc2 shall go low.

When the i_hc_en is set to 0 and i_imp_en is set to 1 and i_n_ecg_channel is equal to 2, ECG1 and ECG2 shall be active so the o_pd_hc2 shall remain high, o_pd_imp_from_bia shall go low and counter shall be work.

source_spans.text: [Covers: DDS_STBIO1_0123] [Covers: DDS_STBIO1_0141] When in IDLE State, if ECG0_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [0]) is high, or BIA_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [2]) is set high, or ECG1_ECG2_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [1]) is set high, or GSR_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [3]) is set high, or ADC_DO_CALIBRATION ( ADC_CAL_CONFIG register [0]) is set high, or WAVE_VELOCITY_MODE (GENERAL_PPG_PARAMETERS_1 register [4]) is set high together wit h PPG_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [4]), when MODE_OPERATION (DEVICE_CONFIG_OPERATION register [1:0] ) is set different from 0, the O_PD_CLKF shall go to 0, the w_en_ldo1v8 shall be set to 1.

When in Sleep Mode, the device shall go back to the Operative State if no error (o_error_irq stuck at 0) occurs and all the operations are ended . Furthermore, if no Bio -Channel operations are selected and more than 150us are left before the start of a new time slot, the o_pd_clkf (Digital Top signal) shall be set to 1, otherwise shall be left to 0.

[Covers: DDS_STBIO1_0116] When the Device_FSM FSM is in BOOT State, that is DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) == 0x01 (main_controller_status_register), it shall wait that the ADSP ends the BOOT Phase, checking when the i_quokka_boot_end is set high. When the BOOT Phase is ended, the Device_FSM FSM shall go to IDLE State, check that DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) == 0x02, (main_controller_status_register), check that the w_en_ldo1v8 signal is set low and that the O_PD_CLKF signal is set to high.

source_spans.text: For GSR Operation, if i_en_cds is set 0, the behavior shall as described in Requirement 143, otherwise the o_write_enabled shall be asserted when i_end_of_coversion is set to 1 and i_n_average_ecg_bia_gsr is equal to their limit values when the measurement is done with o_gsr_curr_on set to 0 and o_gsr_on set to 1

If the en_gsr_cds [bit 3 of GSR_CTRL] is set High, the i_m_gsr shall define also in which time slot after the GSR_Curr_on falls from 1 to 0, an acquisition without current injection (o_gsr_curr_on set to 0) shall be performed.

If en_gsr_cds is set high [bit 3 of GSR_CTRL] the GSR_SNS (acquisition with o_gsr_curr_on set to 1) and GSR_CDS (acquisition with o_gsr_curr_on set to 0) shall be sampled 16 times, then mediated to get one single value for each of them, and then the final result shall be the subtraction between GSR_SNS and GSR_CDS. On the other hand, If en_gsr_cds is set low, no acquisition of GSR_CDS shall be done and the result shall be the average of 16 acquisitions of GSR_SNS.

issue_classes.parser_or_projection_limitation: Approved text is present; its grammatical or functional relationship is not correctly represented. This is not demonstrated source absence.
issue_classes.missing_source_information: A specifically identified item is demonstrably absent in the cited approved scope; the missing item and scope must be stated explicitly.
issue_classes.non_prose_misclassification: Structured content was incorrectly treated as a prose obligation; its existing non-prose output path preserves it.
issue_classes.source_model_relationship_review: The source checker found a relationship mismatch; affected meaning must not be published until safely reconciled.
issue_classes.stale_alignment: Existing generated claims, audits or artifacts do not match the currently applied contract; this is not missing technical meaning.
issue_classes.essential_descriptive_blocker: A required descriptive section or its explicit dependency cannot be supplied from supported approved meaning.
issue_classes.source_information_not_established: A bounded review has not established a named behavior or qualifier. Neither true source absence nor a parser-only cause is proven.
issue_classes.intentional_exclusion: Evidence is deliberately excluded by admitted scope or information-gain rules; exclusion is not source damage.
issue_classes.publication_quality_violation: Rendered text or presentation violates an existing publication rule; no new technical requirement is implied.
issue_classes.historical_observation: A preserved prior diagnostic has no demonstrated active blocking effect; its exact evidence remains available for review.

rules: Every issue also requires a reader-facing blocking_reason.
Only an explicitly confirmed, scoped absence may be classified as missing_source_information.
Unestablished information is not automatically missing source information.
If user clarification is not actually required, both user_clarification_needed and clarification_type are none.
Parser fixes, source clarification, structured routing and stale-artifact alignment are separate decisions.
Historical observations do not override current artifact gates or create approval authority.
